description:
A designer and manufacturer of interactive entertainment hardware and accessories, listed on the stock market since 1998 and active in this field since, Guillemot Corporation bases its activities around its two flagship brands: Hercules and Thrustmaster.


Thrustmaster takes pride in its core values, ‘Passion, Quality and Innovation’, and constantly strives to improve the realism and immersiveness in legendary game worlds by offering thrilling and truly exceptional experiences. From video game enthusiasts to casual gamers, Thrustmaster accessories for PC and gaming consoles such as racing wheels (Ferrari® F1 wheel replica and the powerful T-GT just to name some) and joysticks (US Air Force licensed) bring everyone’s dreams to life.

Hercules: For over 30 years, we have focused on innovating and developing digital audio solutions which continue to inspire users with endless new possibilities. We constantly draw on our roots in analog audio, in order to offer cutting-edge devices, celebrated for their precision and sound quality.

Hercules created the first dual-deck mixing controller for computers featuring a built-in audio interface. Since then, Hercules has ranked among the leading manufacturers of portable DJ controllers for computers.


Skills, Knowledge and Expertise:

  • Bachelor or Master degree in Computer Science, Automation, Electronics and Telecommunications, Informatics, Mathematics or you are a student at one of those;
  • Minimum 2 years experience in Software Development for Desktop;
  • Good knowledge of C/C++/C# programming languages;
  • Good knowledge of Windows and Mac Operating Systems;
  • Debugging and problem-solving skills;
  • Good communication skills;
  • You are self-motivated;
  • Well written and good verbal English skills.


Nice to have:

  • You are enthusiastic about computer-based music production and performance or/and PC and consoles video games;
  • Sound programming;
  • CI/CD automation knowledge;
  • QT knowledge;
  • Knowledge of Agile methodology.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop software according to the design document using C++ as the main programming language;
  • Document the code;
  • Implement solutions at the best quality, in due time;
  • Debug, test and optimize applications;
  • Accurately estimate and plan tasks;
  • Permanently be up to date about new programming technologies.


We offer:

  • Hybrid work schedule (2 days/week WFH);
  • Meal tickets (33 RON/worked day);
  • Extra days off;
  • Medical subscriptions in partnership with Sanador (with special offers for family members);
  • Gift vouchers for Easter, Christmas, Children’s day;
  • 50% reimbursement for the monthly public transportation subscription;
  • Discounted prices for Guillemot products
  • Access to all our products (racing wheels, fly simulator joysticks, video game controllers, DJ consoles and controllers);
  • Free access to an IT & Dev training platform;
  • Long term visibility in terms of projects.
